summary: OpenAI released version 0.0.8 of the gpt-oss repository, adding new Metal MoE kernels for faster prefill, fixing a resource leak, adding sharded checkpoint support, and polishing the Python/browser code.

practices.reason: The repo ships new MoE kernels that speed up prefill on Metal, a reproducible serving-stack change for anyone running gpt-oss locally.
practices.quote: Speeding up prefill with new moe kernels by @ibahmed-oai in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/192

practices.reason: Converter now supports sharded checkpoints, a small change to how models are loaded via Metal that teams using the converter should be aware of.
practices.quote: Metal: support sharded checkpoints in the converter by @Maratyszcza in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/195
